{{CharInfobox |color={{normal color}} |corecolor={{normal color light}} |bordercolor={{normal color dark}} |name=Baron Alberto |jname=アルベルト男爵 |tmname=Baron Alberto |slogan=no |image=Alberto.png |size=100px |caption=Baron Alberto |gender=Male |hometown=[[Alamos Town]] |region=[[Sinnoh]] |relatives=Unknown |trainer=no |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=M10 |epname=The Rise of Darkrai |enva=[[List of English voice actors|Ax Norman]] |java=[[Kōichi Yamadera]] }} '''Baron Alberto''' (Japanese: '''アルベルト男爵''' ''Baron Alberto'') is a minor antagonist who appeared in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]''. ==In animation== [[File:Baron Lickilicky.png|thumb|left|250px|Baron Alberto as a {{p|Lickilicky}}]] Alberto first appeared while [[Alice]], {{Ash}}, and {{ashfr}} were investigating some severely twisted pillars in [[Godey]]'s garden. He was adamant that {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}, a longtime resident of the garden, was behind the bizarre occurrence and sought to prove his point. During the events of the movie, Alberto was [[Human–Pokémon transformation|transformed]] into a {{p|Lickilicky}} due to a combination of Darkrai's {{m|Dark Void}}, {{mov|Palkia}}'s interference with space, and his Lickilicky's dream of becoming Alberto. Angered by this, Alberto assembled a group of {{pkmn|Trainer}}s to deal with it. Later on, he returned to his normal form when the effects of Dark Void faded, and became a bystander for much of the destructive battle between Palkia and {{mov|Dialga}}. Alberto appeared again during the ending credits of ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]''. He was piloting his own hot air balloon and still attempting to win over Alice's heart. He also made a cameo appearance in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a continuity separate from {{aniseries|PTS}}. He was seen with his Lickilicky in [[Alamos Town]]. ===Character=== Implied to have some sort of influence in [[Alamos Town]], Alberto is chauvinistic and vain. He was quick to assign blame of strange occurrences to {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}} and take charge of the situation when it become apparent that Darkrai was a threat. Even when proven wrong, Alberto maintained his sense of judgment and dismissed the objections of others. The extra attention from {{TRT}}, who [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|posed as a news crew]], only inflated Alberto's ego. He is particularly hostile towards {{OBP|Tonio|M10}} and often insulted him, a relationship compounded by his one-sided romantic affections for Alice. Alberto openly declared that he wanted to marry her, and continued to pursue her even though she indicated her lack of romantic interest in him. ===Moves used as Lickilicky=== {{anmov/h|normal||Baron Lickilicky {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Lick|1=Gyro Ball|2=Wrap}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Lick|1=Gyro Ball|2=Wrap}}}} {{anmov|Ghost|Lick|M10|The Rise of Darkrai}} {{anmov|Steel|Gyro Ball|M10|The Rise of Darkrai}} {{anmov|Normal|Wrap|M10|The Rise of Darkrai}} {{anmov|Normal|Hyper Beam|M10|The Rise of Darkrai{{tt|*|Not used. Seen from Lickilicky}}}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} This listing is of Baron's known Pokémon: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Baron Alberto |pkmn=Lickilicky |type1=Normal |img=Baron Alberto Lickilicky.png |epnum=M10 |epname=The Rise of Darkrai |desc={{p|Lickilicky}} is Alberto's main Pokémon. It is first seen during {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}'s first appearance when it tries to use Hyper Beam, but misses, resulting in Darkrai firing back a {{m|Dark Void}} which ends up hitting {{Ash}}. Later Lickilicky gets hit by Darkrai's Dark Void, causing it to fall into a nightmare. Due to {{mov|Palkia}}'s space disruption, this nightmare causes Baron Alberto to transform into Lickilicky. {{TRT}} is later seen carrying Lickilicky while it was asleep. After Lickilicky wakes up it tries to save [[Alice]] from falling off a bridge but fails leaving {{OBP|Tonio|M10}} to help her. Lickilicky briefly reappeared in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a continuity separate from {{aniseries|PTS}}. His role in the manga is not too different from the original, but his infatuation with Alice is not mentioned. He first appears when Ash and the others notice the Alamos Town Gardens have been ransacked, explaining that he believes that all of the trouble happening in [[Alamos Town]] is caused by {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}, and swears that he will be the one to defeat it. He works with {{TRT}}, thinking that they are working on a documentary about him. After attempting to defeat Darkrai, it transforms him into a Lickilicky as it did in the movie. He is restored to normal after their rematch. Alberto is present during the final battle and realizes Darkrai had only wanted to protect Alamos Town all along. {{sectionstub}} ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Baron's known Pokémon: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Baron Alberto |width=80 |pkmn=Lickilicky |type1=Normal |img=Baron Alberto Lickilicky M10 manga.png |epnum=The Rise of Darkrai (manga) |epname=Strange Happenings Around Town |desc=Like in the movie itself, {{p|Lickilicky}} is also Alberto's main Pokémon in the manga adaptation of the movie. None of Lickilicky's moves are known.}} ==Trivia== * Alberto's name is likely a pun on the Japanese name of {{p|Lickilicky|his Pokémon}}, causing him to be called "Baron Berobelt" (compare: '''アルベルト''' ''{{tt|Aruberuto|Alberto}}'' and '''ベロベルト''' ''{{tt|Beroberuto|Berobelt}}'') several times. He keeps his name in the dub and is called "Baron Lickilicky"; thus eliminating the pun. Adding to the joke, his overall appearance is based on a Lickilicky. * Alberto is the second human in the {{pkmn|animated series}} to be [[Human–Pokémon transformation|transformed into a Pokémon]] [[Ashachu|after]] {{Ash}}. ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #{{normal color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{normal color}}" !
